source: RePoE poe2 export (github.com/repoe-fork/poe2, data/mods.json, fetched 2026-10-26; contains 0.5 "Runes of Aldur" data). Display text cross-checked with poe2db.tw/us/Waystones (107 "Waystones Mods" rows, 19 "Desecrated Waystone Mods").
notes: Every waystone-tier band has its own mod id; a waystone can ONLY roll the band matching its tier (T16 always gets tier-4 values). All spawn weights are 1 (equal) within a band.
Reward lines are "_final" (multiplicative, "more") except map_map_item_drop_chance_+% (increased) on the disabled RareMonstersAdditionalModifier mod.
Ground-effect group MapSpreadGroundEffect has 3 variants (ignited/chilled/shocked) sharing one group => only one per waystone, 3x total weight of a normal family.
